name: Theme Button
description: A pill button that morphs into a picker menu on click using a shared layoutId. Click the font name to choose a typeface or the color swatch to choose a theme. Fully configurable: pass your own themes/fonts (list or function), control the selection, and react to picks via onThemeChange/onFontChange. The shell springs open with an Apple-style expand/collapse, content cross-fades with a blur, and the whole surface is theme-token aware for light and dark.

variations.name: default
variations.previewHint: Click the font name or the color swatch — the sample text below reacts to your pick
variations.description: Collapsed status pill morphs into an expanded font or theme list via a shared layoutId spring, with a blur cross-fade on the inner content. Themes/fonts, selection, and change callbacks are all props. Includes an inlined iOS pulse spinner so the block ships self-contained.

props.name: themes
props.description: Theme options as a list or a function returning one. Each: { id, label, dots: string[] }. Falls back to the built-in set.

props.name: fonts
props.description: Font options as a list or a function returning one. Each: { id, label, stack }. Falls back to the built-in set.

props.name: defaultThemeId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial theme selection, by id.

props.name: defaultFontId
props.description: Uncontrolled initial font selection, by id.

props.name: themeId
props.description: Controlled theme selection, by id. When set, the theme dimension is controlled.

props.name: fontId
props.description: Controlled font selection, by id. When set, the font dimension is controlled.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Fires with the full option after a theme is picked — do whatever you want with it.

props.name: onFontChange
props.description: Fires with the full option after a font is picked.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the menu opens ('font' | 'theme') or closes (null).

props.name: processLabel
props.description: Label shown next to the spinner segment.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the pill shell.

features: Morphs between collapsed pill and expanded menu via a shared layoutId — Motion interpolates size, position, and border-radius in one spring
Runs an asymmetric Apple-style spring: expand at 0.4s with slight bounce, collapse ~30% faster with none
Cross-fades inner content with a blur; exit runs ~25% faster than enter so old content clears before the morph lands
Implements the full APG menu pattern: role="menu" with menuitemradio options, roving tabindex, and focus returned to the opening trigger
Respects prefers-reduced-motion — the morph spring, cross-fade, and spinner all collapse to instant

featureSections.title: Shared Layout Morph
featureSections.summary: Morphs the collapsed pill into the expanded picker menu by bridging two elements with a shared layoutId, driven entirely by open/close state.
points: Interpolates size, position, and border-radius between pill and menu via one shared layoutId
Keeps morph-driven values (border-radius, padding, width) inline so Motion can interpolate them
Runs an asymmetric Apple-style spring in perceptual duration/bounce terms: expand at 0.4s with slight bounce, collapse ~30% faster with none
Swaps the two shells through AnimatePresence in popLayout mode so the exiting element leaves the layout flow immediately

featureSections.title: Content Cross-fade & Blur
featureSections.summary: Cross-fades the inner content separately from the shell morph using opacity, blur, and a slight scale, with ease-out timing.
points: Fades content through a 4–6px blur, adding a 0.96 scale on the menu side
Runs exits ~25% faster than enters so outgoing content clears before the morph lands
Uses an ease-out cubic so content reads instantly then settles
Pins content with layout="position" so text never stretches during the shell morph

featureSections.title: Menu Accessibility
featureSections.summary: Implements the full APG menu pattern with focus management, roving tabindex, and a reduced-motion fallback.
points: Marks triggers with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded; options are menuitemradio with aria-checked inside role="menu"
Moves focus onto the selected option on open; Arrow/Home/End rove between options via roving tabindex
Returns focus to the opening trigger on Escape or selection; outside-click dismissal leaves focus where the user clicked
Hides decorative spinner, color dots, and dividers with aria-hidden
Respects prefers-reduced-motion — the morph spring, cross-fade, and spinner all collapse to instant

featureSections.title: State & Configurability
featureSections.summary: Handles selection per dimension as controlled or uncontrolled, with all options and callbacks exposed as props.
points: Accepts themes and fonts as arrays or functions, falling back to built-in sets
Controls each dimension independently: themeId/fontId for controlled, default*Id for uncontrolled
Reports every interaction via onThemeChange, onFontChange, and onOpenChange
Ships self-contained — the iOS pulse spinner is inlined verbatim, not imported
Expands hit targets to full segment and row height with negative-margin padding, without shifting the visible layout
